title: GeoDrop onboarding storyboard & explainer map for region-aware latency routing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a set of onboarding visual assets and a short explainer storyboard that clearly demonstrates Redwood's region-aware latency routing. Deliverables: (1) 4-frame storyboard that walks a new user from default routing -> observed latency spike -> automatic region fallback -> final steady-state with reduced latency; (2) a hero map visual (SVG + 2 raster sizes) that shows latency bands and routing decision arrows, with both orthographic and flattened (Mercator) variants; (3) two console mock screenshots showing the routing toggle + per-request trace overlay; (4) an animated GIF (loop) ~6s that highlights fallback path and model variant swap; (5) accessible color palette and alt-text strings for docs. Key design trade-offs: keep the hero map abstracted (no live telemetry) to avoid implying real-time fidelity; prefer vector overlays for crispness in console but provide raster fallbacks for email and PDF. Chosen approach: simplify geographic division to 6 region buckets to reduce cognitive load and align with routing policy UI. Coordinate with Eng for latency thresholds and with PM for onboarding script text. Export-ready assets will include Figma file, flattened PNGs (2x), SVGs optimized for web, and a short copy deck for docs.
